repos.description: Updated list of public BitTorrent trackers
repos.summary_zh: 提供每日自动更新的公共 BitTorrent tracker 列表，涵盖 UDP、HTTP、HTTPS、WebSocket、i2p 和 Yggdrasil 等多种协议。包含域名与 IP 两种格式，通过自动化检测去重，优化 P2P 文件共享的连接效率与稳定性，适用于 BT 客户端配置及去中心化网络应用场景。
repos.summary_en: Daily automatically updated public BitTorrent tracker lists supporting multiple protocols including UDP, HTTP, HTTPS, WebSocket, i2p and Yggdrasil. Provides both domain and IP address formats, with automated deduplication to optimize P2P file sharing connectivity and stability for BT clients and decentralized network applications.

repos.summary_zh: edgetunnel 2.0 是基于 Cloudflare Workers/Pages 的边缘计算隧道管理方案，深度集成 VLESS 与 Trojan 协议。提供可视化后台面板，支持实时配置、日志监控与流量统计。内置自动订阅系统，兼容 Clash、Sing-box、Surge 等主流客户端。支持自定义 ProxyIP、链式代理及优选 API 加速，适配 Windows、Android、iOS、MacOS 及软路由固件，部署方式灵活高效。
repos.summary_en: edgetunnel 2.0 is a Cloudflare Workers/Pages-based edge computing tunnel solution with deep VLESS and Trojan protocol integration. It features a visual management panel for real-time configuration, log monitoring, and traffic statistics. The built-in subscription system auto-generates configurations compatible with Clash, Sing-box, Surge and other clients. Supporting custom ProxyIP, chain proxies, and optimized APIs, it accelerates performance across Windows, Android, iOS, macOS and router firmware with flexible deployment options.

repos.description: 【编程随想】收藏的电子书清单（多个学科，含下载链接）
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库是'编程随想'博主整理的跨学科电子书库，涵盖政治、技术等多个领域。核心亮点在于采用Resilio Sync P2P技术实现去中心化分发，支持免翻墙自动同步，规避审查与流量限制。提供PDF/EPUB/MOBI等全格式支持，并附带详细的阅读技术指南，构建了一个抗审查的数字知识分发体系。
repos.summary_en: This repository hosts cross-disciplinary e-books curated by 'ProgramThink', covering politics, technology, and more. Its core innovation leverages Resilio Sync P2P technology for decentralized distribution, enabling censorship-resistant, auto-syncing downloads without VPN. It provides comprehensive format support (PDF/EPUB/MOBI) and detailed technical guides, forming a robust anti-censorship digital knowledge dissemination system.

repos.description: Simple and easy to use DDNS. Support Aliyun, Tencent Cloud, Dnspod, Cloudflare, Callback, Huawei Cloud, Baidu Cloud, Porkbun, GoDaddy, Namecheap, NameSilo...
repos.summary_zh: ddns-go 是一款用Go开发的轻量级动态域名解析工具，支持阿里云、腾讯云、Cloudflare等20余家主流DNS服务商。可自动检测公网IPv4/IPv6地址变化并实时同步至域名记录，适用于家庭宽带、小型服务器等动态IP场景。提供Web管理界面、Docker部署方案及系统服务化运行能力，支持多平台、多架构与Webhook通知。
repos.summary_en: ddns-go is a lightweight Dynamic DNS client built with Golang, supporting 20+ major DNS providers like Aliyun, Tencent Cloud, Cloudflare and more. It automatically detects public IPv4/IPv6 address changes and synchronizes them to domain records in real-time, perfect for home broadband, small servers and IoT devices with dynamic IPs. The tool offers a user-friendly web interface, Docker deployment, system service integration, multi-platform compatibility (Windows/macOS/Linux, ARM/x86/RISC-V) and customizable webhook notifications.

repos.summary_zh: Technitium DNS Server 是开源跨平台权威/递归DNS服务器，支持自托管以提升隐私与安全。开箱即用，提供Web控制台，可网络级拦截广告与恶意软件，支持DoT/DoH/DoQ加密协议、集群管理、LDAP/OIDC认证及高性能异步IO。适用于家庭与企业网络，内置缓存、DNSSEC与应用扩展框架，显著提升解析速度与控制力。
repos.summary_en: Technitium DNS Server is an open-source cross-platform authoritative and recursive DNS server for self-hosting with strong privacy and security focus. It works out-of-the-box with a web console, enables network-wide ad/malware blocking, supports DoT/DoH/DoQ encrypted protocols, clustering, LDAP/OIDC auth, and high-performance async I/O. Ideal for home and enterprise networks, featuring advanced caching, DNSSEC, and an apps framework for enhanced control and speed.

repos.description: nodejs-argo是一个强大的Argo隧道部署工具，专为PaaS平台和游戏玩具平台设计。它支持多种代理协议(VLESS、VMess、Trojan)等，有直连协议(Socks5、Hysteria2、Reality)可选开启，并集成了哪吒探针功能
repos.summary_zh: nodejs-argo是一个专为PaaS平台和游戏玩具平台设计的Argo隧道代理部署工具，支持VLESS、VMess、Trojan等多种协议，并集成哪吒探针功能。基于Node.js实现，支持环境变量配置的固定/临时隧道、订阅生成及自动保活，适用于个人代理节点搭建。核心亮点包括多协议兼容、哪吒监控集成及npm模块化部署。
repos.summary_en: nodejs-argo is a powerful Argo tunnel deployment tool designed for PaaS and game toy platforms. It supports multiple proxy protocols including VLESS, VMess, and Trojan, with integrated Nezha probe functionality. Built on Node.js, it enables easy configuration via environment variables for fixed or temporary tunnels, subscription generation, and auto keep-alive, ideal for personal proxy node setup on cloud platforms. Key highlights include multi-protocol support, Nezha monitoring, and npm package deployment.

repos.description: 既然来了，就留下你的Star吧！Serv00 | CT8 | Hostuno | VPS | 游戏机 | sing-box(reality + hy2 + vmess-argo +tuic5)四合一无交互一键安装脚本(已适配Alpine)，支持纯V6 vps，丰富的分流服务, 可添加anytls,socks5,ss-2022等协议
repos.summary_zh: sing-box多协议代理一键安装脚本，支持VLESS-reality、VMess-ws-tls(Argo)、Hysteria2、Tuic5等协议，适配VPS、Serv00、CT8、Alpine等环境。集成哪吒探针、Argo隧道与订阅管理，提供无交互部署、端口自定义与分流服务，适合快速搭建代理节点与网络加速场景。
repos.summary_en: One-click installation script for sing-box multi-protocol proxy, supporting VLESS-reality, VMess-ws-tls (Argo), Hysteria2, Tuic5. Compatible with VPS, Serv00, CT8, Alpine and more. Integrates Nezha monitoring, Argo tunnels and subscription features for automated deployment, custom ports and traffic routing in proxy and acceleration use cases.

repos.description: The RethinkDNS resolver that deploys to Cloudflare Workers, Deno Deploy, Fastly, and Fly.io
repos.summary_zh: Serverless-dns 是一个自托管的无服务器 DNS 解析器，提供类似 Pi-Hole 的内容过滤功能，支持 DNS-over-HTTPS 和 DNS-over-TLS。它可一键部署到 Cloudflare Workers、Deno Deploy、Fastly 和 Fly.io 等边缘平台，利用其免费层即可满足10-20台设备的日常需求。服务器处理延迟仅0-2毫秒，端到端延迟中位数为10-30毫秒，具备全球覆盖能力。
repos.summary_en: Serverless-dns is a self-hosted, serverless DNS resolver with Pi-Hole-like content blocking, supporting DNS-over-HTTPS (DoH) and DNS-over-TLS (DoT). It deploys effortlessly to edge platforms including Cloudflare Workers, Deno Deploy, Fastly, and Fly.io. The free tiers suffice for 10-20 devices monthly. Server processing takes 0-2ms, with end-to-end latency of 10-30ms (median), enabling global low-latency DNS resolution.

repos.description: 提升部署在cloudflare、vercel或netlify的网页在中国的访问速度和稳定性   cf优选域名 | cf优选ip | cloudflare | vercel | netlify | 加速 | 国内 | 中国 | 境内 | 大陆
repos.summary_zh: 该项目通过自定义CNAME解析，优化Cloudflare、Vercel和Netlify服务在中国大陆的访问体验。核心机制是定时测试各平台IP的速度与稳定性，优选出最佳节点并配置三网解析，将国内流量引导至最优线路，海外使用官方IP。相比官方Anycast常将流量路由至东南亚导致拥堵，此方案能有效改善晚高峰时段的访问速度和连通性稳定性，仅需修改DNS记录即可实现，特别适合部署在海外FaaS平台的中文网站加速。
repos.summary_en: This project enhances access speed and stability for websites hosted on Cloudflare, Vercel, or Netlify in mainland China through custom CNAME redirection. It automatically tests IPs from these platforms every 40 minutes, selecting optimal nodes for China's three major ISPs while using official IPs overseas. By bypassing problematic anycast routing that often directs Chinese traffic to Southeast Asia, it significantly improves connectivity during peak hours and prevents single-point failures. The solution requires only DNS configuration changes, making it ideal for accelerating Chinese access to overseas serverless deployments.

repos.description: Warp+Psiphon, an anti censorship utility for iran
repos.summary_zh: Warp-Plus是基于Cloudflare Warp的开源实现，深度集成Psiphon链式代理，专为伊朗等高审查环境打造的抗审查工具。支持Warp-in-Warp双层隧道改变虚拟NAT位置、SOCKS5代理、端点扫描与跨平台部署（含Termux），提供快速、安全且灵活的翻墙VPN解决方案。
repos.summary_en: Warp-Plus is an open-source Cloudflare Warp implementation enhanced with Psiphon chaining for robust censorship circumvention in restrictive regions like Iran. It features Warp-in-Warp dual tunneling to shift virtual NAT locations, SOCKS5 proxy support, endpoint scanning, and cross-platform compatibility including Termux, delivering a fast, secure VPN solution for unrestricted internet access.

repos.description: a multi node frp webui and for https://github.com/fatedier/frp server and client management, which makes this project a Cloudflare Tunnel/Tailscale Funnel/Ngork platform and agent open source alternative
repos.summary_zh: FRP-Panel 是 frp 的开源可视化管理平台，提供集中式配置、多节点编排与边缘 Worker 部署能力。项目采用 Master-Server-Client 架构，支持 WireGuard 智能组网与动态调度，可替代 Cloudflare Tunnel 等商业服务，大幅简化 NAT 穿透与内网服务暴露的运维复杂度，实现统一认证与实时监控。
repos.summary_en: FRP-Panel is an open-source visual management platform for frp that provides centralized configuration, multi-node orchestration, and edge Worker deployment capabilities. Adopting a Master-Server-Client architecture, it supports WireGuard smart networking and dynamic scheduling, serving as a self-hosted alternative to commercial services like Cloudflare Tunnel. The platform significantly simplifies NAT traversal and internal service exposure operations while enabling unified authentication, real-time monitoring, and zero-configuration credential distribution across distributed environments.

repos.description: Connector for decentralised post-quantum secure network - VeilNet
repos.summary_zh: VeilNet Conflux 是连接去中心化抗量子安全网络的节点软件，采用改进 WebRTC 栈实现点对点通信。核心特性包括基于污点（taint）的访问控制机制，节点需共享污点才能互联；支持 Terra 免费无区域 Realm 和 Conduit 互联网共享模式。通过优化 Exp3 路由算法和自动连接配对，提供低延迟、高吞吐的安全网络连接，适用于构建抗量子威胁的分布式通信基础设施。
repos.summary_en: VeilNet Conflux is a node connector for decentralized post-quantum secure networks, utilizing a modified WebRTC stack for P2P communication. Key features include taint-based access control requiring shared taints for node connectivity, free regionless Terra Realm, and Conduit mode for internet sharing. Optimized with the Exp3 routing algorithm and automatic connection pairing, it delivers low-latency, high-throughput secure networking, ideal for building quantum-resistant distributed communication infrastructure.

repos.summary_zh: AetherGate Pro 是企业级高可用 VPN 与代理网关管理工具，专为 Linux VPS 设计。通过网络命名空间（netns）隔离技术，避免主机接口污染和 SSH 断连问题。支持单端口混合 SOCKS5/HTTP 代理，自动抓取 VPNGate 节点并过滤欺诈风险，配备玻璃拟态仪表盘与自愈看门狗，实现稳定可靠的代理服务，适用于代理网络工程师构建企业级网关。
repos.summary_en: AetherGate Pro is an enterprise-grade, high-availability VPN and proxy gateway manager for Linux VPS. It uses network namespace (netns) isolation to eliminate SSH disconnections and routing conflicts on the host. It features a single-port mixed SOCKS5/HTTP proxy, auto VPNGate scraping with fraud filtering, a glassmorphic dashboard, and self-healing watchdog for seamless, reliable proxy services tailored for network engineers.

repos.summary_zh: EdgeTunnel (Refactored) 是 Cloudflare Workers 的轻量级隧道代理工具，支持 VLESS 和 Trojan 协议。模块化 ESM 架构支持 Wrangler 部署、KV 配置与订阅生成。核心价值为工程化 Serverless 代理方案，易扩展二次开发。适用于网络代理与边缘计算场景，性能依托全球边缘网络。
repos.summary_en: EdgeTunnel (Refactored) is a lightweight tunnel proxy tool on Cloudflare Workers supporting VLESS and Trojan protocols. It uses a modular ESM architecture for easy Wrangler CLI deployment, local debugging, and Git version control. Configuration is managed via Cloudflare KV, with automatic subscription link generation for clients like Clash and Sing-box. The core value is an engineering-friendly, extensible Serverless proxy solution ideal for developers to learn Worker development and WebSocket communication. It leverages global edge network for performance in secure tunneling and proxy scenarios.

repos.description: Open-source network quality monitoring platform with multi-node Ping, TCPing, HTTP, DNS, IPv6 and Traceroute testing.
repos.summary_zh: 开源多节点网络质量监控平台，支持Ping/TCPing/HTTP/DNS/Traceroute/IPv6探测。采用Master+Agent+RabbitMQ架构，基于RuoYi-Vue-Plus、Next.js与Prometheus Blackbox，提供Agent自动上下线、一键部署、IP地理解析及广告系统，助力企业低成本搭建网络运维与测速平台。
repos.summary_en: Open-source multi-node network quality monitoring platform supporting Ping, TCPing, HTTP, DNS, Traceroute and IPv6. Built with Master+Agent+RabbitMQ architecture using RuoYi-Vue-Plus, Next.js and Prometheus Blackbox. Features auto Agent management, one-click deployment, IP geolocation and ad system for low-cost enterprise network ops.

repos.description: Script to submit both IPv6 and IPv4 addresses to DuckDNS
repos.summary_zh: 该脚本解决DuckDNS不支持IPv6自动更新的问题，通过Shell实现IPv4/IPv6双栈地址自动提交。自动检测NAT环境，一键配置并创建cron定时任务，适用于家庭服务器和物联网设备。轻量级设计，依赖curl等基础工具，确保在提供服务的设备上直接运行。
repos.summary_en: This script resolves DuckDNS's lack of IPv6 auto-update support by automatically submitting both IPv4 and IPv6 addresses via Shell. It detects NAT environments, provides one-click configuration with automated cron job setup, and is ideal for home servers and IoT devices. Lightweight design relies on curl and standard tools, ensuring direct execution on service-providing devices.
